name: FedProx + cosine-gated server momentum
tagline: FedProx local objective plus a server EMA whose momentum coefficient is set each round by the cosine alignment of the new pseudo-gradient with the running buffer.
diff_from_baseline: Versus fedprox baseline this layers a cosine-gated server-side momentum on top: when consecutive rounds' pseudo-gradients agree the server smooths with EMA, when they disagree it falls back to pure FedAvg-step. Versus fedavg it adds the proximal client term and the whole momentum gate.

name: Loss-weighted average + server momentum
tagline: Plain SGD locally; weights clients by $n_i/(1+\gamma\,\ell_i/n_i)$ then maintains a fixed-beta EMA of the round delta as server momentum.
formula: $$ w_i = \frac{n_i}{1 + \gamma\,\ell_i / n_i},\quad \bar w = \sum_i \frac{w_i}{\sum_j w_j} \cdot \theta_i $$ $$ \delta_t = \bar w - \theta^{t},\;\; m_t = \beta m_{t-1} + (1 - \beta)\,\delta_t,\;\; \theta^{t+1} = \theta^{t} + m_t $$
diff_from_baseline: Versus fedavg this both reweights clients by inverse-per-sample-loss (small effect at gamma=1e-3) and adds a global EMA server momentum on the aggregated delta. No client-side proximal/SCAFFOLD correction.

name: FedProx + variance-shrunk + bias-corrected momentum
tagline: FedProx local objective; server applies a per-coord James-Stein-style shrinkage by client-update std, then Adam-style bias-corrected momentum.
formula: $$ \mu_k = \sum_i w_i\,(\theta_i - \theta^t)_k,\;\; \hat v_k = \sum_i w_i (\delta_{i,k} - \mu_k)^2 \cdot \frac{\sum_i w_i^2}{1 - \sum_i w_i^2} $$ $$ s_k = \frac{|\mu_k|}{|\mu_k| + \sqrt{\hat v_k} + \epsilon},\;\; \tilde\delta_k = s_k \mu_k $$ $$ m_t = \beta m_{t-1} + (1-\beta)\tilde\delta,\;\; \hat m_t = m_t / (1 - \beta^{t+1}),\;\; \theta^{t+1} = \theta^t + \hat m_t $$
init_recovers: FedProx + plain server momentum if shrinkage s_k → 1
diff_from_baseline: Versus fedprox it adds two server-side stages: (1) per-parameter signal-to-noise shrinkage of the mean update using the across-client standard error, and (2) Adam-style bias-corrected EMA. Local loop is identical to FedProx.

name: Consensus-aligned clipped momentum
tagline: Cyclic non-replacement client sampling; server reweights clients by cosine alignment with the round consensus, clips to median norm, and adds light momentum.
init_recovers: Approx FedAvg if all clients aligned and same-norm
diff_from_baseline: Versus fedavg this adds (a) cyclic no-replacement client sampling, (b) cosine-alignment reweighting, (c) median-norm clipping of outlier client deltas, and (d) server EMA momentum. Local SGD is unchanged (no FedProx/SCAFFOLD term).

name: DRAMA: adaptive prox + momentum (broken)
tagline: Adaptive per-client FedProx where mu rises with the client's loss trajectory; intends server-side directional reweighting and adaptive-LR momentum but submission is incomplete.
init_recovers: FedProx at mu_base when loss is flat, FedAvg at mu_base→0
diff_from_baseline: Versus fedprox this turns mu into a per-client function of recent loss trajectory and uses backward hooks to add the proximal term to gradients. Server-side DRAMA pieces (cosine reweighting, drift-adaptive LR) are described but the submitted Strategy class lacks aggregate() and select_clients(), so the run would fall back to base-class behaviour or crash.
